title: Develop workspace: shell, widget library, generated panels and canvas modes
objective: Implement the accepted Develop workspace design over the pixel, transform and crop modules with a layered desktop, a core-free widget crate, API parity for every visible control and native M4 evidence.
context_summary: The current desktop is one Iced file with generated controls and the M4 crop draft. This plan restructures it into widget, view-model, view and update layers, adds the small core additions the design lists, and delivers the panels, canvas modes, bars, keymap, palette and evidence. Basic, histogram, export, Locate, heal and mask stay out of the build.

tasks.description: Add the core descriptor, history, recipe and session additions the workspace needs, each visible through the JSON API and covered by API tests.
extra_context: Only the additions in the design's core-additions table: hint, module and group reset, action summary templates rendered into a stored entry label (catalog format 3), ToolModule::describe_layer with recipe.describe, canvas title and shortcut, developer flag, ClientSession.workspace with workspace.set, OwnerHandle::start_with and LocalServer::connected.
Built-in modules declare: pixel developer true, summary '({x}, {y})' style label, transform summary '{transform}', crop summaries and module reset crop-reset, crop canvas title 'Crop' shortcut 'R'.
Format 2 catalogs are refused explicitly by the format marker; nothing is migrated or rewritten.

acceptance_criteria: module.list shows hint, reset, developer, summary, canvas title and shortcut on the built-in descriptors and the registry rejects an undeclared reset action, a preset out of range, a summary placeholder naming no parameter and a duplicate shortcut.
Every committed entry carries a label rendered from the template with the documented formatting; Original and restore entries are labelled by the host; history.list and asset.state return it.
recipe.describe lists an entry's layers with module id, title, summary and availability, and reports an unavailable provider's layers with the reason.
session.state reports workspace state and workspace.set validates the mode against registered canvas modules.
A format 2 catalog is refused with an explicit incompatible error and left unchanged.
The performance checklist is answered: no request path decodes, renders or hashes anything new.

steps: Extend descriptor, registry, methods and editor tests for each addition.
Add a command-contract test that drives every new method through dispatch.
expected_results: All checks pass; the JSON method table lists recipe.describe and workspace.set with notes.

tasks.description: Create the lightwell-ui widget crate: theme tokens and the widget set from the design, depending on Iced only.
extra_context: Widgets: bipolar slider with editable value and draft, typing and invalid states; section header with dot and reset; sub-group header; icon button; segmented control; chip; list row for history, version and recipe rows; notice card; floating bar; mode strip; inline menu.

Every widget takes plain data and callbacks generic over the message type and holds no editing logic; the fill from the zero tick uses the slider rail's two backgrounds with gradient stops computed from the value.
Justify the crate boundary in the crate's lib.rs doc comment and record that it adds no startup work.

tasks.description: Restructure the desktop into app, state and view layers with a pure view model, keeping every current behaviour and evidence path.
extra_context: state/ derives title bar, state panel, tools panel sections, canvas, status bar and palette models from core state without Iced; view/ renders models only; app/ holds Editor, messages, update, owner tasks, evidence, keymap and the crop driver.
Add the repository boundary check: no iced under state/, no lightwell_core under view/ or in lightwell-ui.
Tools sections carry an input version and re-derive only when their inputs change.

tasks.description: Build the canvas, mode strip, draft bar, notices, title bar, status bar, keymap and compare.
extra_context: Five regions at 1440 by 900 default; the canvas pads the photo by 20 pt at Fit; the mode strip floats at the bottom with pointer, each declared canvas mode and the thirds overlay; the draft bar sits at the top during a crop draft.
Notices: Changed elsewhere with Discard and Reapply, Preview is stale naming the unavailable provider, Original not found, rendering limits. No Locate, Export or Clipping controls.

Keymap in one file: existing shortcuts plus F, 1, backslash hold, O, V, module shortcuts, Cmd+K, Cmd+Option+[ and ]. Letters act only when no text field has focus. Panels, mode and thirds go through workspace.set.
Evidence surface columns derive from the layout with panel visibility.
